title: fix(console): refuse an internal form's write up front when the caller holds no grant
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbDSw9FNbgkETV4DyaGwPTDJ)_

Fixes #29187

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：成员打开一个自己没有新建权限的表单链接时，页面一加载就直接显示「您没有权限保存这条记录。」，不再画出可填写的表单；编辑表单（带记录 ID）同理按编辑权限判断。两个登录后的表单地址行为一致，匿名公开表单不变。
- **为什么改**：以前只读成员能把整张表单填完，点提交才被拒，填的内容白费。
- **风险与回滚**：风险低，只影响没有对应权限的人；有权限的人看到的表单完全不变。回滚即还原这一个 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` 新增的拒绝分支；`ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx` 中 `/forms/:name` 移入权限布局的那一处。
- **两分钟验证**：用只有读权限的成员打开 `/_console/forms/showcase_project.form`，应只看到一行红色的无权限提示，没有任何输入框；管理员打开同一链接仍是完整表单。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **One mechanism, named: `/forms/NAME` moves under `ConsolePermissionsScope`.** The app-less internal form route was a sibling of the console's permissions layout, under `ProtectedRoute` alone, while its in-app twin `/apps/APP/forms/NAME` sat under it. It is now a child of the same pathless layout route as `/home` and `/apps/APP/*`, so both form URLs read the one `/auth/me/permissions` answer the console already holds. The URL is unchanged, deep links keep working, and a hop from Home or an app keeps the layout, so the answer is not asked again. `/f/SLUG` stays outside it (anonymous, no answer, no request).
- **`FormPage` refuses up front.** Once the form has loaded (it needs the form view to know its object), internal mode asks the affordance map's form row through `resolveAffordance` from `@object-ui/core`, the predicate the app's own create and edit forms read: `createFormFields` (the create grant) for a create form, `editFormFields` (the update grant) for an edit form (`?recordId=`), each intersected with the object's effective API operations. Refused, the page draws the submit-time refusal's own sentence (`form.noPermissionToSave`, the one #29019's PR #29184 uses) in a `role="alert"` banner and no field, no Submit. With the grant, nothing changes. No new i18n key, no metadata key, no server change.
- With no permissions provider above it (the public route, a bare harness), `usePermissions()` reads every grant open, so `/f/SLUG` and every existing `FormPage` test behave as before.

## Tests

- `FormPage.upfrontWriteRefusal-29187.test.tsx` (8 cases, real `MePermissionsProvider` fed the served payload shape): create without the create grant is refused with no textbox and no POST, on `/forms/NAME` and `/apps/APP/forms/NAME`; create with it renders the form; the update grant alone does not open a create form; an edit form without the update grant is refused even with create; with it the form renders prefilled; `/f/SLUG` draws its fields both under a no-create answer and with no answer at all.
- `FormPage.routePermissions-29187.test.tsx` (4 cases, real `App` route tree and `ConsolePermissionsScope`): `/forms/NAME` renders under the answer, asked once; the loading screen shows before it; `/home` then a form link asks `/auth/me/permissions` once in total; `/f/SLUG` has no permission context and makes no request.
- Ablation: replacing `mode === 'internal' &&` in the new guard with a never-true test (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to `git diff HEAD` empty) reds exactly the four refusal cases; the four grant and public cases stay green.

## Acceptance notes

- **Requests on a cold `/forms/NAME` deep link.** The permission check costs one request, `/auth/me/permissions`. The same layout also holds `LauncherAppsProvider`, so a cold deep link now asks `/me/apps` too, as `/home` does: the form page's header launcher now narrows the apps it offers the way Home's does, where before it listed every app. A hop from Home or an app asks neither again.
- **The policy half reads the default bucket.** `FormPage`'s object payload keeps only `name`, `label`, `fields` and `fieldGroups`, so `resolveAffordance` is given no `objectSchema` and an object-level `userActions` opt-out or a managed bucket does not refuse here; the grant and the effective API operations do. The card asked for the grant; widening the payload is a separate change.
- The refusal state carries no button of its own; both routes keep the console header for navigation.

## Verification

Live on a fresh showcase (`pnpm dev -- --fresh`, source Console on Vite), a member created through `auth/admin/create-user`, holding only the `everyone` baseline: `showcase_project` read only, `showcase_task` read + create, no edit. Before = `main` at `5780fa49`, after = this branch.

| Case | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| member, `/forms/showcase_project.form` | full form, 8 inputs, Submit | refusal sentence, 0 inputs, no Submit |
| member, `/apps/showcase_app/forms/showcase_project.form` | full form, Submit | refusal sentence, 0 inputs, no Submit |
| member, `/forms/showcase_task.form` (create allowed) | form | form, unchanged |
| member, `/forms/showcase_task.form?recordId=ID` (no edit) | edit form, Submit | refusal sentence, 0 inputs |
| admin, same edit link | edit form | edit form, unchanged |
| anonymous, `/f/contact-us` | form, Submit | form, unchanged, 0 permission requests |

Screenshots for every row (`before-*.png`, `after-*.png`) are in the project folder `issue-29187/`.
